key: They keep sayin', "South Obsidia is our next project." "We'll get to it, just be patient."
en: They keep sayin', "South Obsidia is our next project." "We'll get to it, just be patient."
ja: 「南オブシディアが次の事業だ」ってずっと言い続けてる。「そのうち手をつけるから、もう少し待ってくれ」ってな。

key: Bruh, South Obsidia been your next project since six next projects ago!
en: Bruh, South Obsidia been your next project since six next projects ago!
ja: おいおい、南オブシディアが「次の事業」だったのなんて、もう六個前の「次の事業」からじゃねえか!

key: I went down and helped out at Beryl, at Lapis, but did they come down and help out here?!
en: I went down and helped out at Beryl, at Lapis, but did they come down and help out here?!
ja: おれはベリルにもラピスにも手伝いに行ったのに、あいつらはここに来て手伝ってくれたか!?

key: Hell nawh, bro.
en: Hell nawh, bro.
ja: ぜんぜん来てねえよ、まったく。

key: System's fucked.
en: System's fucked.
ja: このシステムはくそったれだ。

key: I hear the city is making plans to take another shot at cleaning the Wasteland.
en: I hear the city is making plans to take another shot at cleaning the Wasteland.
ja: 街がまた「不毛地帯」の浄化に挑もうとしてるって聞いたぜ。

key: Impossible, I would say.
en: Impossible, I would say.
ja: 無理だろうな、と俺は思うね。

key: But I would have said the same for this city itself.
en: But I would have said the same for this city itself.
ja: だが、この街自体についても同じことを言っていただろうさ。

key: There may be hope yet.
en: There may be hope yet.
ja: まだ希望はあるかもしれないな。

key: Don't even look at me unless you about to start layin' bricks.
en: Don't even look at me unless you about to start layin' bricks.
ja: レンガ積みでも始める気がないなら、おれに構うんじゃねえよ。

key: This city's already full of pish-posh folks who ain't gotta care to lift a finger for anyone who got less cash than care.
en: This city's already full of pish-posh folks who ain't gotta care to lift a finger for anyone who got less cash than care.
ja: この街はもう、金のない連中のために指一本動かそうとしない気取った連中でいっぱいだ。

key: Salon de Glamazonia
en: Salon de Glamazonia
ja: サロン・ド・グラマゾニア

key: 'Nother day pass, 'nother day that go by they ain't do nothin' about these conditions here.
en: 'Nother day pass, 'nother day that go by they ain't do nothin' about these conditions here.
ja: また一日過ぎるたび、あいつらはここの状況について何もしやしない。

key: Fuck 'em!
en: Fuck 'em!
ja: くたばれ!

key: You can take the slums outta the guy, but you can't take the guy outta the slums.
en: You can take the slums outta the guy, but you can't take the guy outta the slums.
ja: スラムから男を連れ出すことはできても、男からスラムを消すことはできねえのさ。

key: It's easy just to stare out at the sea here.
en: It's easy just to stare out at the sea here.
ja: ここでただ海を眺めてるのは楽なもんだ。

key: I can forget that there's still so much work to do.
en: I can forget that there's still so much work to do.
ja: まだやるべき仕事が山ほどあるってこと、忘れられるからな。

key: Do I have to do it?
en: Do I have to do it?
ja: やらなきゃいけないのか?

key: Oh, Adrienn is recruiting at the Coral Gym again?
en: Oh, Adrienn is recruiting at the Coral Gym again?
ja: あら、アドリエンヌがまたコーラルジムで人を募集してるの?

key: Hah, to tell the truth, I was in the work crew before, but I've been slacking.
en: Hah, to tell the truth, I was in the work crew before, but I've been slacking.
ja: はっ、正直に言うと、前は作業班にいたんだけど、サボってたんだ。

key: I guess I'll report back in.
en: I guess I'll report back in.
ja: 戻って報告してくるとするか。

key: > - Lilycove Street\n^ - 10th Street
en: > - Lilycove Street\n^ - 10th Street
ja: > - リリーコーブ通り\n^ -10番街

en: > - Jubilife Street\n^v - 10th Street
ja: > - ジュビライフ通り\n^v -10番街
